question: Shinzo Abe, who recently died, served as Prime Minister of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Japan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Shinzo Abe, Japan’s longest-serving prime minister, died after being shot while giving a campaign speech.
 
• Mr. Abe, who was 67 years old, was prime minister until late 2020 and was one of Japan’s best-known politicians.
 
• On 26 September 2006, Abe was inaugurated as Japanese Prime Minister elected at the age of 52, he was the youngest prime minister since Fumimaro Konoe in 1941.
 
• He was the de facto leader of the largest faction in the ruling Liberal Democratic Party and wielded strong influence in the government despite standing down as prime minister in September 2020.
 
• Abe also served as Chief Cabinet Secretary from 2005 to 2006 under Junichiro Koizumi and was briefly leader of the opposition in 2012.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**About Japan:**

 
• Prime Minister: Fumio Kishida
 
• Capital: Tokyo
 
• Currency: Yen
 
• Language: Japanese
